How the bank is built

      

        Biochemistry and Genetics are multiple choice with worked rationales.
        Epi & Biostats are calculation problems instead — recognising the definition of
        sensitivity is a flashcard, but computing it from a 2×2 you had to build yourself is a skill, and skills
        need reps. You mark those yourself against the worked solution.

      
Multiple-choice options are shuffled every attempt, so there is no letter pattern to learn.
